items.t: Timing chain rattle or breakage
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner (2.2L)
items.note: If the chain already broke and bent valves, owners report about $2,600 for an engine rebuild.

items.t: Timing chain links can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace timing chain (recall)

items.t: Ignition module failure causes rough idle and power loss (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition control module (recall)

items.t: Timing belt failure can wreck the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idlers (3.0L V6)
items.note: Adding the water pump at the same time costs a little more in parts. A belt that breaks can mean a new engine.

items.t: Body control module failure
items.job: Replace and program body control module

items.t: Doors lock and unlock by themselves
items.job: Diagnose power locks and replace a door lock actuator
items.note: If the body control module is the cause, the cost is higher.

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold from a failed compressor
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, receiver-drier and recharge

items.t: Harsh or erratic automatic shifting
items.job: Replace pressure control solenoid / valve body solenoids
items.note: A replacement transmission runs around $1,800 or more if internal damage is found.

items.t: Fuel pump failure leaves the car unable to start
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module

items.t: Check engine light with rough running
items.job: Diagnose and replace oxygen sensor, EGR valve or coil

items.t: Brake lights can fail from a warped tail lamp (recall)
items.job: Install reinforced tail lamp sockets (recall)

items.t: Wagon rear seat belt anchor can pull loose (recall)
items.job: Install seat belt anchor reinforcement plate (recall)

items.t: Turn signals can stop working from the hazard switch (recall)
items.job: Replace hazard switch (recall)

items.t: Fuel tank valve could spill fuel in a rollover (recall)
items.job: Seal or replace fuel tank valve (recall)

items.t: Rear seat belt buckles may not hold (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat belt buckles (recall)

items.t: Shifter can show Park when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Install shift cable clip and adjust cable (recall)

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace wiper motor (recall)

items.t: Wheel bearing hum or grinding
items.job: Replace wheel hub and bearing assembly, one wheel

items.t: Power steering pump, hose or rack leaks
items.job: Replace power steering pump or hose (rack in worse cases)
items.note: One owner was quoted about $1,900 for a rack, pump and related work.

items.t: Check engine light from a loose or worn gas cap
items.job: Replace gas cap

items.t: Bumper cover keeps coming loose
items.job: Replace bumper cover clips and brackets (cover if damaged)

items.t: Oil cooler or oil filter housing leak
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler and oil filter housing, flush cooling system (3.0L V6)
items.note: Parts: dealer oil cooler about $378 plus $60 filter housing (FenderBender shop report). YourMechanic: $1,314–$1,418 estimate for 2001–2003 V6, $1,571–$2,329 at shops. A cracked filter housing alone costs much less.

items.t: No-start or stalling from a failed crankshaft sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor (3.0L V6)
items.note: Basis: RepairPal, $244–$267 total (no parts-plus-labor source found).

items.t: Heater core or heater hose leak wets the floor
items.job: Replace heater core and refill coolant
items.note: Basis: RepairPal, $486–$649 total by year (no parts-plus-labor source found). A leaking heater hose or O-ring alone costs much less.
